mountpoint.description: Absolute path to the directory where the GNUnet-shared filesystem will be mounted.

source_uri.description: GNUnet file-sharing URI (CHK or LOC) of the directory to mount. Required.

config_file.description: Optional path to a GNUnet configuration file; if empty, the default config is used.

loglevel.description: Verbosity of logging: one of ERROR, WARNING, INFO, or DEBUG.

single_threaded.description: If true, disable FUSE concurrency for debugging (sequential request handling).
